faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLE580 use?
faqLeft.a: The GLE580 uses the M176 - a 4.0-litre V8 twin-turbo with mild hybrid assistance. It was introduced with the V167 generation in 2019 and remains the flagship non-AMG V8 in the GLE-Class range.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLE580 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLE580?
faqLeft.a: The GLE580 uses the M176 V8 across the entire V167 generation. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M176 GLE580 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components, and bearings as standard on every M176 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLE580 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLE580 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLE580 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLE580 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
